snippet.title: Identity V - Closing Night Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Dear Visitors,
The uproar returns – let's unravel the mysteries!
This November, we revive the Manor's past in a fresh narrative, plunging you into games of bizarre splendor. 
What truth lies behind the nightmarish revels of the Hullabaloo? Please stay tuned!

Source: https://twitter.com/GameIdentityV/status/1786707208060994030
